kamloops.title: Woven baskets gifted to Okanagan elder, replacing those lost to wildfire
kamloops.description: A B.C. woman who read an Okanagan Indian Band elder's story of losing treasured items in the Bradley Creek wildfire gifted him four woven baskets, believed to be of Syilx origin, from her home.

kamloops.title: Orange Shirt Society kiosk opens in Kamloops, after years of companies selling unaffiliated merchandise
kamloops.description: After years of unaffiliated companies profiting off of Orange Shirt Day, the founder of the Orange Shirt Society has opened her own kiosk to sell official merchandise bearing the society's legal trademark to the term "Every Child Matters."

southeast.title: Cranbrook mayoral candidates differ on experience, public safety and growth ahead of vote
southeast.description: Public safety, economic growth and experience are emerging as key points of contrast between the two candidates running to become Cranbrook's next mayor.

all.title: Why are B.C. firefighters still using wildfire data from the 1990s?
all.description: Prolonged drought in B.C.'s Southern Interior has led to explosive wildfires that current modelling software struggles to predict. It's partly because the data that informs these computer models was collected at least 30 years ago, when extreme fire behaviour, driven by events like prolonged drought — a feature of climate change — was less common.
